correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and every 1<=k<=2n, the proof exhausts four core–pendant pair types. A strict improvement exchange excludes B/U coexistence; the Schur complement and Sherman–Morrison identity give the exact rational trace. For k<n, F is strictly convex and F(k-1)-F(k-2)<0, leaving two endpoints whose difference is -T_n(k)/(k(k+n)(n+1)). For k>=n, the strictly negative H_r consecutive difference selects all leaves. Strict comparison determines every optimizer and count. Independently constructed exact grounded matrices agree for all 1356 nonempty subsets at n=2..5 and 635312 rational profile comparisons n=2..60; these computations are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural dense-core network with one private sensor/pendant per vertex has an explicit exact placement rule for every leader budget. The polynomial threshold produces a non-obvious switch from one core to leaves only at k/n approaching sqrt(3)-1, and the result proves nonnested optimal leader sets plus exact counts and performance. This is a structural all-budget optimum, not an isolated small enumeration or normalization check.
